agency.name: Division of Mental Health and Addiction Services (DMHAS), New Jersey Department of Human Services

narrNote: New Jersey does NOT appear on NARR's official affiliate list (narronline.org/affiliates, fetched 2026-10-22), so narrAffiliate is null per doctrine. An organization calling itself the NJ Alliance of Recovery Residences (NJARR) exists historically, but it is not on NARR's current official list and was therefore not listed.
notes: DMHAS is New Jersey's Single State Agency for substance use services (per SAMHSA's SSA directory, confirmed via NASADAD's SSA listing and on nj.gov); the agency URL is DMHAS's official substance-use help page, fetched and content-checked this run. agency.phone is null: a general DMHAS number seen in an nj.gov PDF via search results was not confirmed on a fetched page this run; the state's published 24/7 addiction line is ReachNJ, listed under stateCrisis. The countyDirectory entry is the NJSAMS directory of licensed NJ substance use treatment services (Rutgers-hosted, state system), searchable, fetched this run; DMHAS also publishes a Community Peer Recovery Centers by County list from its substance-use page. Peer orgs: the New Jersey Coalition for Addiction Recovery Support (NJ-CARS) is the statewide recovery community organization (confirmed via nj.gov), and its website (nj-cars.org) was fetch-verified live in the 2026-10-22 backfill pass — the homepage carries NJ-CARS's mission verbatim — so it is listed in peerOrgs; the listed peer entry, NJ Connect for Recovery, is a peer-specialist-staffed family support line run by the Mental Health Association in New Jersey and funded by DMHAS (its About page was fetched and content-checked). Medicaid: NJ FamilyCare (Medicaid) covers SUD services — the outpatient continuum moved into managed care on Jan 1, 2025, while short/long-term residential and opioid treatment programs remain fee-for-service — but no single official consumer-facing Medicaid SUD page could be fetch-verified in this run, so medicaidSud is null rather than guessed. Every URL in this file was fetched and content-checked on 2026-10-22.
